answer: The prism signs a head's work into the pulse only when that head's vault, locked alone, holds twice the stake of the operator's largest live vault; a vault caught backing two heads in one pulse is forfeited. The first head locks base copper, each later head locks double its forerunner — a fourth head alone locks 8base — so k clones tie up base(2^k−1) in locked vaults while a lone newcomer locks base once.
